expected_sha256.description: If set, the file must currently hash to this or the write fails with E-FS-STALE

title: write_file input
description: Create a file, or replace one entirely, with the given content. Prefer edit_file for changes to an existing file. An existing file's line endings and BOM are preserved. Pass expected_sha256 (from read_file) to refuse the write if the file has changed.
